entities.summary: Teimuraz Bagrationi, otherwise known as Tsarevich Teimuraz Georgievich, was a Georgian royal prince (batonishvili) and scholar primarily known as an author of the first critical history in Georgian as well as for his work to popularize interest in the history and culture of Georgia and preserve its treasures.
